ideas.pitch: A human-in-the-loop audit agent built using UiPath Maestro BPMN that validates country-specific privacy compliance for national identity partner integrations before data sync with the core MOSIP resident database.
ideas.title: MOSIP-Guard: BPMN-Orchestrated Biometric Data Consent Audit Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets MOSIP’s guiding principles of privacy, security, and modularity using a proven hackathon pattern of BPMN-orchestrated agentic workflows.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router using kNN and exemplar indexing to instantly direct localized citizen service inquiries to the correct national micro-service endpoints across multilingual dialects.
ideas.title: Aadhaar/MOSIP-Bridge Semantic Query Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the severe scalability and multi-tenant routing challenges faced by governments adopting MOSIP across 31 countries with diverse languages.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed offline verification tool that runs Poisson regression forecasting and local cryptographic validation for remote field officers syncing decentralized MOSIP credentials.
ideas.title: Offline-First Credential Verifier for Remote ID Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact rural infrastructure limitation of intermittent internet connectivity that 31 developing nation adopters struggle with.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first agent leveraging edge models to help elderly or digitally illiterate citizens navigate complex national biometric re-authentication flows without falling victim to local fraud.
ideas.title: Voice-First Elder Identity Recovery Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a high-impact social welfare use-case with agentic voice technology, matching the winning formula of global good and senior accessibility hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance server log and audit tracking system tailored for national ID registrars to ensure immutable record-keeping of administrator access to citizen PII.
ideas.title: MOSIP-Log: Zero-Knowledge Server and Audit Log Management
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on foundational security auditing requirements needed by government ministries deploying sovereign digital ID platforms.
